blocks.text: A graduate of Kingfisher School of Business and Finance has been named the topnotcher of the October 2026 Certified Public Accountants (CPA) Licensure Examination, the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced.
Tyron Jones Timoteo Acuña garnered the percentage rating of 92.00, the highest among 3,988 successful examinees.
